plan: Given my value of $13, I should bid slightly below it to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their value. To win, I need to outbid them but not exceed my value. A bid around $12 might outbid a competitor with a value near mine, ensuring I pay less than my value if I win.

Given my value of $15, I aim to bid below my value to ensure profit if I win. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their value. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value but above half of it to outbid low bids. A bid of $12 balances winning chances and profit margin, assuming others bid near their values.
